verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that GitHub's documentation, which hosts the Copilot docs, serves a live llms.txt at docs.github.com/llms.txt. They also confirm a Markdown version of the Copilot documentation at docs.github.com/copilot.md, so an agent can be pointed at either llms.txt or agent-readable docs. missing for 10: a Copilot-specific llms.txt (the probed file is GitHub-wide), first-party documentation describing these agent-oriented doc formats, and independent corroboration of agents using them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://docs.github.com/copilot.md # GitHub Copilot documentation
